in_marathi.name: Sharunikaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharunikaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharunikaa is a name derived from the Sanskrit and Tamil languages, meaning 'Goddess of Love and Prosperity'. This name is a combination of 'Sharu' which means 'Goddess' and 'Nikaa' which means 'Prosperity'. It is believed that Sharunikaa is a symbol of love, loyalty, and prosperity.
